blocks.x: It's going now Thomas. Tell me your name. That was Valentine. And what do they call you? Kid Thomas. Kid Thomas huh? Where were you born? Resilient. And when? That was 1860. Some six or something. Well listen, what's the day? The day is January the...
Yeah, it might be January where they are. They ought to be January 12th. Yeah.
January the 27th. Yeah, yeah. 27. I got it on my watch. Yeah, 27, 1969. I just want to get it on there so they'll know who you are. Yeah, sure.
When did you start playing in here, Thomas? I don't know, I was around about 60 years or so.
